citations.S1: builds the query by string interpolation with values that come straight from the HTTP request
citations.S2: **Connection/cursor never closed — high.** `conn` and `cur` are left open on every call
citations.S3: `"Order #" + order[0]` raises `TypeError: can only concatenate str` on every real order
citations.S4: `total / len(orders)` raises `ZeroDivisionError` when a user has no orders
citations.S5: Floating point isn't safe for currency (rounding drift accumulates). Use `Decimal`.
citations.S6: A negative `pct` increases the price instead of discounting it; a `pct > 100` produces a negative amount
citations.S7: **No status validation / no allow-list — medium.** ... If there's a fixed set of valid statuses, validate against it
citations.S10: `str(1.5)` renders `"$1.5"` instead of `"$1.50"`. Round/format to 2 decimal places.
citations.S11: propagates as a raw exception up through the HTTP handler; depending on the framework this can leak internals in a 500 response
